Camps, Adult Classes and Workshops

title.text: Registration now open for Summer Session and Summer Camp!

cards.class_tags: Mixed media, drawing, painting, clay camps

quick_description.text: Summer camp for kids in rising 1st-3rd grade! Different theme each week!

description.html:
This summer we are offering 7 different weeks of camps for rising 1st-3rd graders. "Art Explorers" is a mixed media camp for our youngest students! Camps run from 9AM-1PM and will incorporate painting, drawing and sculpting. Each session will have different projects and themes so campers will have a different approach to art making each week of camp. We will have one teacher and one assistant and the camp will be capped at 8 students for a 4/1 ratio. Campers will need to bring a lunch. All the art supplies needed and a snack will be provided.

Session 1 June 1-5 Glitter and Sparkle

Session 2 June 8-12 Extraordinary Animals

Session 3 June 15-19 Magic and Mythology

Session 4 June 22-26 All About Me

Session 5 July 6-10 Creature Feature

Session 6 July 13-17 Our Natural World

Session 7 July 20-24 Forts and Castles

cards.class_tags: Mixed media, drawing, painting, clay camps

description.html:
This summer we are offering 7 weeks of camps for rising 3rd-6th graders. There are 4 different themes to choose from. Clay Play, Book Making, Painting and Drawing and Mixed Media. Camps run from 9AM-1PM. Each session will have different projects and themes so campers will have a different approach to art making each week of camp. We will have one teacher and one assistant and the camp will be capped at 8 students for a 4/1 ratio. Campers will need to bring a lunch. All the art supplies needed and a healthy snack will be provided.

Camp runs Monday - Friday from 9AM-1PM.

June 1st-5th Clay Play

June 8th-12th Book Arts

June 15th-19th Caly Play

June 22nd-26th Mixed Media

July 6th-10th Drawing and Painting

July 13th-17th Book Arts

July 20th-24th Drawing & Painting

This summer we are offering higher level intensive classes for tweens (rising 6th-8th grades), who want to build their skills in a supportive and focused environment. Each class meets from 2-4PM on Monday-Friday of the assigned week. All the supplies are included. 

June 8th-12th we are offering a Book Arts class that will explore the fun of making your own books through a variety of mediums as well as creating serialized content such as comics. In our painting & drawing intensive June 8th-12th, we will be exploring observational drawing, watercolor, and acrylic painting techniques.

Book Arts June 8th-12th 2-4PM

Drawing & Painting July 6th-10th 2-4PM

quick_description.text: Friday adult workshop to connect and unwind - bring your own refreshments. June 12, 6:30-8:30pm with Clancy Provence

description.html:
Create a one-of-a-kind picture using soft, colorful felt in this fun and approachable workshop. You’ll learn simple techniques for cutting, layering, and assembling felt to build images full of texture and personality. Whether you choose to make something whimsical, abstract, or inspired by nature, this project invites creativity at every step. With guided instruction and plenty of room to experiment, you’ll leave with a finished piece and the skills to keep exploring felt-based art at home. Materials will be provided - just bring a willingness to learn and have fun! Bring-your-own refreshments are welcome.

Friday, June 12, 6:30-8:30pm

Clancy Provence is an Atlanta-based watercolor illustrator whose personalized portraits capture the people she loves through whimsical detail and warm, expressive storytelling.

cards.class_tags: An adult + child (age 6-10) creative activity. Saturday, June 13, 1-2:30pm

quick_description.text: Bring a child (ages 6-10) for some special creative time! Saturday, June 13, 1-2:30pm with Shannon Kelly

description.html:
FLEXAGONS

Is it a toy? Is it art? YES! Flexagons are folded paper polygons that can be rotated to reveal 3 unique faces. It is a fun collaborative design challenge that unites your inner engineer with your inner Picasso! All materials will be provided.

Saturday, June 13, 1-2:30pm

Shannon Kelly, co-owner of Arts Beacon, is a long-time educator and watercolor artist. She loves to help students of all ages to find joy and connection through process-based art projects.

title.text: WORKSHOP: Guest Artist - Stacked & Stitched Journals

cards.class_tags: Make a mixed media journal, June 13

quick_description.text: Make a beautiful bound journal. Saturday, June 13, 3-5pm with Jennifer Cuthbertson

description.html:
Learn how to create a fun, simple stacked and stitched journal using everyday materials. In this workshop, we’ll make pamphlet-stitched book sections (signatures) from scrapbooking and mixed media papers, then assemble them into a unique journal for art or everyday note-taking. We’ll also decorate our journals and create a spread on the first two pages together to get you started. No prior journal-making or sewing experience is needed—just come ready to explore and create something special you can use every day. All materials provided.

Saturday, June 13, 3-5pm

Jennifer Goad Cuthbertson is a mixed media artist based in Atlanta, GA. Her creative practice began with the written word, evolving into art journals and eventually expanding to paper and other surfaces. Collage and mixed media allow Jennifer to indulge her love of vintage paper and ephemera while exploring a range of materials and discovering what emerges through their combination. She is particularly drawn to the intersection of experience and memory, and how they merge, fragment, and recombine over time.

quick_description.text: Make space for wellness with mindful art at the solstice. Saturday, June 20, 3-5pm with Stacey Shulman

description.html:
Join Stacey Shulman for an afternoon of creative expression and community. We’ll begin with gentle breathwork and a guided meditation to help you settle in and connect. You’ll then be invited to create a Summer Solstice Vision Board—a meaningful way to clarify your intentions and invite positive energy for the season ahead. Each participant will also receive a reading from the Deck of Divine Guidance to uncover a personal theme for the summer. Enjoy light refreshments as we welcome the season together. All materials provided.

Saturday, June 20, 3-5pm

quick_description.text: Interested in working more with textiles? Give needle felting a try! Saturday, June 27, 3-5pm with Anna Zelski

description.html:
Felting is a fun and accessible artform that turns dyed wool into colorful art pieces you can carry around with you. During this one-day class, you will create a personalized needle-felted keychain! In this workshop, you’ll learn everything you need to begin your needle felting journey, including essential terminology and materials to get started. The small-group format is perfect for sharing ideas and sparking creativity. All materials provided.

Saturday, June 27, 3-5pm

quick_description.text: Friday adult workshop to connect and unwind - bring your own refreshments. July 10, 6:30-8:30pm with Clancy Provence

description.html:
Personalize your cooler!

Get game-day and concert-ready with a custom-painted cooler! In this fun, hands-on workshop, you’ll transform a plain cooler into a bold, personalized piece perfect for fall football tailgates and summer concerts. We’ll explore simple painting techniques, color layering, and design ideas to help you create something eye-catching and durable. Whether you go for team spirit, music-inspired graphics, or your own unique style, you’ll leave with a functional piece that stands out wherever you take it. (Bring your favorite cooler - we will provide the rest!) Bring-your-own refreshments are welcome.

Friday, July 10, 6:30-8:30pm

Clancy Provence is an Atlanta-based watercolor illustrator whose personalized portraits capture the people she loves through whimsical detail and warm, expressive storytelling.

cards.class_tags: An adult + child (age 6-10) creative activity. Saturday, July 11, 1-2:30pm

quick_description.text: Bring a child (ages 6-10) for some special creative time! Saturday, July 11, 1-2:30pm with Shannon Kelly

description.html:
Sew a Plushie!

Everyone loves a squishy friend. Why not make your own? In this collaborative activity, studio sidekick teams will dream up the design for a plushie pal and build it using felt, fabric, string and fabric markers. Beware: once you start designing your own plushies, you might not be able to stop! All materials provided.

Saturday, July 11, 1-2:30pm

Shannon Kelly, co-owner of Arts Beacon, is a long-time educator and watercolor artist. She loves to help students of all ages to find joy and connection through process-based art projects.

quick_description.text: Make a beautiful beaded pendant or earrings! July 11, 3-5pm with Ashley Hersey

description.html:
Bead your very own pendant or earrings in this beginner-friendly workshop! You’ll be introduced to the materials, tools, and techniques central to the craft of beadweaving and learn how to read a pattern. No experience or tools required - simply choose from a selection of bead colors and follow along with guided instruction. Exercise your dexterity, mindfulness, and creativity all at once and leave with a wearable piece of art! All materials provided. Extra kits available for a small fee payable to the instructor.

Saturday, July 11, 3-5pm

Ashley Hersey is a jewelry designer who focuses on the modern expression of traditional beadweaving. Owing to her background in engineering, she enjoys the methodical and technical aspects of beadwork.

title.text: WORKSHOP: The Healing Art of Visible Mending

quick_description.text: Make space for wellness with the healing activity of visible mending. Saturday, July 18, 3-5pm with Anna Zelski

description.html:
Visible mending invites you to see new possibilities in worn and loved garments. Instead of automatically throwing away clothes with holes, rips, or stains, we will embrace sustainability  through the art of mending. This therapeutic workshop is designed to breathe new life into your garments by highlighting imperfections rather than hiding them. In this small-group setting, you’ll explore a variety of creative, eye-catching mending techniques and transform your pieces in a mindful, meditative way. All materials provided.

Saturday, July 18, 3-5pm

quick_description.text: Always been curious about watercolors? Come give them a try! Saturday, July 25, 3-5pm with Jaffia Royes

description.html:
This exploratory workshop is the perfect place to start exploring the joys of watercolor. You’ll be introduced to essential techniques like washes, and brush control while getting a feel for the fluid, expressive nature of watercolor. With guided instruction and plenty of room to play, this session offers a relaxed space to experiment, get inspired, and enjoy the process of painting. All materials provided.

Saturday, July 25, 3-5pm

quick_description.text: Make beautiful marbled paper and fabric! August 8, 3-5pm with Purna Ahuja

description.html:
Experience the magic of suminagashi, the traditional Japanese art of floating ink on water. Create beautiful marbled papers and fabrics through a process that is equal parts meditative, playful, and surprising. No two prints are ever alike, and no artistic experience is required—just a willingness to explore and create. All materials provided.

Saturday, August 8, 3-5pm

Purna Ahuja is a graphic designer turned art educator. She began her career as a graphic designer in New York and Atlanta, specializing in children’s books. Her passion for design and educational materials inspired her to transition into art education.
Purna spent twenty-one years as an art educator with Gwinnett County Public Schools, where she encouraged students to develop not only artistic skills but also critical thinking, empathy, and self-expression. Currently, Purna works part-time as a teaching artist at the High Museum of Art, where she facilitates both school and adult education programs.

cards.class_tags: Start here on your creative journey in drawing

quick_description.text: Drawing is the foundation to all of our other classes! Tuesdays 6:00-8:00pm with Jaffia Royes

description.html:
This class is for anyone who would like to explore the basics of drawing! Drawing is the structure beneath almost any creative endeavor, it’s an incredible meditative tool and is deeply grounding. This is a perfect class for beginners to start to find some tools as well as for more seasoned drawers to have a space to remember the basics and start fresh again. Some supplies included. A detailed supply list will be sent after sign up.

  • 8 week session
  • Time: Tuesdays 6-8pm
  • Now registering for Summer Session - June 1- July 31

quick_description.text: Strengthen your drawing techniques. Mondays 2:00-4:00pm with Jaffia Royes

description.html:
Curious about how to create stronger depth, more dynamic compositions, or bring greater precision and expression into your work? This drawing class invites you to dig deeper into technique and process. Through focused exercises and exploratory approaches, you’ll refine your observational skills, experiment with new methods, and develop a more confident, intentional drawing practice.

  • 8 week session
  • Time: Mondays 2-4pm
  • Now registering for Summer Session - June 1- July 31

quick_description.text: Explore the basics of watercolor painting. Tuesdays 2:00-4:00pm with Jaffia Royes

description.html:
This beginner-friendly class is perfect for those new to watercolor or looking to revisit the basics. You’ll focus on fundamental techniques that make watercolor such a unique and expressive medium, including washes, color mixing, layering, and brush control. As you learn to work with the fluid, luminous qualities of paint and water, you’ll build confidence through guided exercises and creative projects in an easy-going, collegial environment. A detailed supply list will be provided after sign up.

  • 8 week session
  • Time: Tuesdays 2pm-4pm
  • Now registering for Summer Session - June 1- July 31

cards.class_tags: Not so beginner anymore watercolor techniques

quick_description.text: Learn how to level up your watercolor techniques! Tuesdays 6:30-8:30pm with Shannon Kelly

description.html:
Splash into some intermediate watercolor techniques! In this class you will explore your personal esthetic in watercolor paintings. We will play with form, tone, and design as we delve into composition and subject matter. We will examine materials, process, and design as you grow in skill and confidence with a community of learners who are all taking the journey together. Basic drawing skills are required, and some watercolor experience is preferred. 

A detailed supply list will be provided after signing up.

  • 8 week session
  • Time: Tuesdays 6:30-8:30pm
  • Now registering for Summer Session - June 1- July 31

quick_description.text: Explore ways to be creative with different types of media. Wednesdays, 6:30-8:30pm with Zoe Iatridis

description.html:
This class is a beginning level, exploratory class that uses a variety of mediums to help each artist find their own best path of expression. We'll explore clay, collage, fiber arts, drawing and painting. Each class will explore how different materials give us a different doorway into creation. We'll get familiar with a variety of media and techniques, becoming more aware of what each medium offers, and utilize playfulness and experimentation to allow a more open ended form of creation. Ultimately this class is useful for students that want to try new mediums or are hoping to get more clarity on which mediums best serve their artistic interest.

Most supplies included. You will need a mixed media sketchbook. 8 week session.

  • 8 week session
  • Wednesdays, 6:30-8:30pm
  • Now registering for Summer Session - June 1- July 31

quick_description.text: Get comfortable painting with acrylics! Thursdays, 2:00-4:00pm with Jaffia Royes

description.html:
New to acrylic painting or ready to refresh your skills? This class offers an inviting introduction to working with acrylics, focusing on how to build color, create depth, and develop confident brushwork. You’ll explore techniques like layering, blending, and surface development while getting comfortable with the medium’s quick-drying, flexible nature. Through a mix of guided exercises and open-ended projects, you’ll gain practical skills and begin to develop your own approach to painting in a relaxed, supportive setting.

  • 8 week session
  • Time: Thursdays 2-4 pm
  • Now registering for Summer Session - June 1- July 31

quick_description.text: Take a deeper dive into acrylics. Mondays 6:00-8:00pm with Jaffia Royes

description.html:
Curious to push your acrylic painting skills a little further? Wondering how to make your colors feel more vibrant, or how to build richer depth and dimension in your work? Join this painting class designed for adults ready to explore beyond the basics. Through guided experimentation and process-based learning, you’ll refine your techniques, expand your visual language, and gain new confidence in how you approach your paintings.

  • 8 week session
  • Time: Mondays 6 -8 pm
  • Now registering for Summer Session - June 1- July 31

cards.class_tags: Playful expressive painting class for adults

quick_description.text: Find your expressive voice in this engaging class, Thursdays 6:30-8:30pm with Erin Drakeford

description.html:
This is a beginning to intermediate class for learning how to engage with colors confidently in your paintings and develop an understanding for how and why you like to use them. This will be a class rooted in play, non judgment and finding expression from your unique voice. You will learn how to let go and trust the process while mixing colors, gaining understanding of various painting techniques and how to develop compositions. 8 week session.

*Suggested (not mandatory) prerequisite Beginning Drawing

A detailed supply list will be provided.

  • 8 week session
  • Time: Thursdays 6:30-8:30pm
  • Now registering for Summer Session - June 1- July 31

quick_description.text: Learn the basics of hand building with clay. Mondays 6:30-8:30pm with Will Durrett

description.html:
This class is designed for those curious about ceramics, as well as those with prior experience who are looking to get back into the swing of things. We’ll learn the basics of hand-building ceramic forms that don’t require the use of a potter’s wheel. In addition to the foundational techniques of slab, coil, and pinch, we’ll cover joining methods, moisture control, and glazing and firing processes. Hand-building offers endless creative freedom—the only limit to what you can create is your imagination.

Students are eligible to come to open studio throughout the semester on Sundays from 10-2:00PM.

  • 8 week session
  • Time: Mondays 6:30-8:30pm
  • Now registering for Summer Session - June 1- July 31

quick_description.text: Advance your clay hand building skills. Thursdays 6:30-8:30pm with Stacey Shulman

description.html:
Designed for advanced beginners and intermediate students, this class builds on foundational hand-building skills while encouraging a deeper exploration of form, design, and function. Through projects and guided support, you’ll refine techniques while developing individual projects that push you to find your artistic voice. This is an opportunity to expand your skills, push your ideas further, and learn in a community of other ceramics lovers. Supplies for this class can be purchased at your local clay store. A detailed supply list will be provided. 8 week session

Students are eligible to come to open studio throughout the semester on Sundays from 10-2:00pm.

  • 8 week session
  • Time: Thursdays 6:30-8:30pm
  • Now registering for Summer Session - June 1- July 31
